items: 【100% polyester fabric】：The outdoor lumbar pillows are made of 100% polyester fabric which is waterproof, stain resistant and colorfast.These waterproof pillows can be used in all seasons,also can be used in indoor or outdoor.
【Soft and Comfortable】：Each lumbar pillow is filled with soft and breathable PP cotton , enough to provide support and feel comfortable when using.

【Functions】：These patio lumbar pillow can not only make you relax in the outdoor,but also add a pop of color to your balcony furniture. Perfect for decorating outdoor garden, patio, balcony, living room, bedroom, party, picnic,cafe, etc.

【Package includes】：Each Outdoor Pillow for Patio Furniture measures 12x20 inches. Package includes 2 pieces of throw pillows.This outdoor lumbar pillow has no zipper and cannot be removed.Please allow +/- 1 inch measurement deviation exist due to hand-cutting and sewing.
【Washing tips】：Wash by hand. Dot Not Bleach. Do Not Iron. If there is a stain, you can use a damp towel to wipe it off.
